briefdescription.para: Loads custom SVG tab button paths from the configured path.

detaileddescription.para: Reads display.tab.button_svg from config. When non-empty, resolves the path (relative paths are anchored to the config directory), parses the SVG, locates the six required elements by ID ("active-left", "active-center", "active-right", "inactive-left", "inactive-center", "inactive-right"), and extracts each as a cached juce::Path via jam::SVG::getPath. Sets hasSvgTabButton true only when all six paths are non-empty. On any failure, emits a DBG warning and leaves hasSvgTabButton false so drawing falls back to the built-in parallelogram.

simplesect.para: MESSAGE THREAD — called at end of setColours().
